sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed the Public Transport Authority's response to two recommendations following an unauthorised disclosure of staff information.
sentences.support: This report details the Commission's review of that response.

sentences.text: The recommendations sought stronger access controls and staff awareness, and the review examined security changes, policies and training.
